name: dimension_that_leaves_the_fillet_alone
why: The twin of `limit_dimension_that_will_not_leave_the_fillet_alone`: the same two fillets of 8, thickness brought to 12 instead of 6. The fillets fit, the extrusion loses no faces, and the change must succeed with the volume of the hand calculation. It proves that the guard on chamfers and fillets that do not fit does not refuse every thinning.

expect.tolerance_why: 120000 minus 2 x (1 - pi/4) x 8^2 x 100 = 2746.9: the calculation has pi inside
100 x 60 x 12 minus the same 2746.9 of the fillets
